data.description: GREEN task. Add apply subcommand to open_count_skew_band.py. Reads manifest, for each skewed type: creates missing Jira issues or closes surplus ones using AcliClient (local count wins). After all mutations, re-runs enumerate_open_count_skew_anomalies() and asserts all deltas are within +/-5 tolerance. Exits 1 with summary if tolerance exceeded. Covers dd-2 (post-pass tolerance) and dd-3 (local-wins).
data.title: Implement open_count_skew_band.py apply subcommand with local-wins reconciliation and post-pass +/-5 verification
